guideEdition: Platinum Desk, evidence edition, 2026-11-20. Every guide below is written for this entry and cites the sources its facts rest on; every step names its backing sources, and a step confirmed by two or more sources is marked 2+ backed.

roadmap.note: The opening hours. Finish Gone Fishing and Chapter 1, and take the Ocean Beach cocktail moment while the game is introducing the beach — it is a one-scene beat, so treat it as missable.
roadmap.title: Shores of Leonida — Prologue & Chapter 1

roadmap.note: Push the story forward. From here on, keep a rotating manual save before any story choice; several later trophies turn on choices and one-time scenes.
roadmap.title: Chapters 2–3 — Vice City Opens Up

roadmap.note: The named story missions unlock across this stretch. The vehicle-showroom smash is a story set-piece: do it when the story puts you in the showroom, in classic style, before moving on.
roadmap.title: Chapter 4 & the Mission Web

roadmap.note: Finish the final mission, then close out every stranger strand: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end in a final mission, and eight strands in total feed the silver Strangers & Freaks.
roadmap.title: The Finale & Stranger Endings

roadmap.note: With the story done, work the activity map: one of each of the 9 activity types first, then the counted grinds — 250 stunts, 42 Shooting Range golds, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins and 50 challenges.
roadmap.title: Open-World Activities Sweep

roadmap.note: Free-roam feats and the opportunity trophies. The choice, second-chance and strange-event trophies (47–50) are the missable heart of this phase: keep old saves until all four are banked.
roadmap.title: Crime, Combat & Chance

roadmap.note: The long tail: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent and all 8 garages bought.
roadmap.title: Collections & the Leonida Economy

roadmap.note: When the in-game completion counter reads 100%, A Long Road (gold) unlocks; the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, follows automatically once the other 54 are earned.
roadmap.title: 100% — The Legend

steps.t: Follow the roadmap in phase order: story and chapters first.
Clear the counted grinds and collections after the finale, not before.
Sweep one filter kind at a time — story, collectibles, activities — so nothing is left behind.
Bank the seven missable-flagged trophies before you overwrite old saves.

steps.t: Learn what registers: a launched jump that lands cleanly on its wheels.
Pick one district and build a loop of its stunt spots.
Run the loop in a fast car or bike until the district is dry.
Move to the next district and build its loop.
Log each session's total in the desk counter when you stop.
Repeat until the counter reaches 250 stunts.
